rulings.a: retest-then-promote accepted as a rule confirmed once here; Andrii's 2026-11-24 verbatim is the sign-off for this one key, recorded as a stated deviation from 8.7; before the first refreshed render: blind audit of the promotion path, then an Opus check (M762 8.7/R4)
rulings.b: drives outside the DEM tiles are reported as coverage only, never imputed, counted separately from 'no cloud data'; E4 selection rows recomputed at each refresh; the change in covered share of logged km is reported in the delta
rulings.c: required: no confirmatory wording; also forbid 'updated', 'confirmed', 'now', 'trend'; never show shares across successive refreshes; the delta is monitoring, not a test
rulings.d: the M767 floors suffice; no minimum of new days, but zero new covered days means skipped_no_new_input (no relabel-only refresh)
rulings.e: keep the trigger, widened: escalate when a class leaves the PREVIOUS displayed interval (also reported against the registered one), changes support status or changes its source-dependent flag: blind audit, then Director, before replacement; every displayed change goes to the owner as one delta line plus SendUserFile

required_changes: promotion cannot run inside cloud_auxiliary (summary_*.json is protected, 7.7): separate post-stage step with isolation-diff splice, rebuild and release_check rerun
release_check R4 'leaf equality with the registered result' becomes equality to the source sha recorded in the block
control R1 at a new master is circular: nested control = steps from the 717 registered drives reproduce M762 C1/C6 exactly (tolerance 0) and the frozen code hash matches
skipped_no_new_input compares to the store manifest of the last promoted or retest run, not the registered one
state whether dem_crosscheck.py (collect_multi) needs its own retest addendum; no M762 file may be written
dem_grade_shares registered mode adopts 8.1 (a stop writes nothing), with a test
wording numbers and the basis label come from the payload; add gate rules
set a timeout for grade_shares and measure it at the dry run
risks: shares shift with changing coverage, not terrain
